caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a lidded tankard, set against a plain, light background. The tankard has a cylindrical body and a domed, hinged lid with a knob on top. The lid features several concentric decorative rings. The handle is large and ornate, curving outward from the side of the tankard and attaching both near the top and bottom of the body; there is also a thumb lever for lifting the lid. The surface of the tankard is smooth and has a metallic appearance, characterized by gradients of gray tones that suggest reflections and highlights typical of polished metal, likely pewter or silver. The base of the tankard displays additional concentric ridges similar to those on the lid. There are inscriptions in small handwriting at the bottom right of the image and no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Silver Tankard
